name: AWS Core
description: The battle-tested, relay-proven AWS core — the only profile shipped in the P0/P1 MVP. Every service here is fully conformance-verified with a real data plane (200+ tests). New profiles are added service-by-service as scope hardens (plan §3.2).
note: aws-core is WASM-realizable (Nano) AND Codespaces/Local-realizable — the shared proof-point of the unified architecture (plan §11).
